**Choices I made where the documents are open (also in the new top-level `notes` key):**
- After a successful e-mail or week change, the agent says "Başka hangi konuda yardımcı olabilirim?" instead of going straight to the main menu. This lets it handle follow-ups like a spouse request.
- No service tells us whether the yearly week-change right is used. The change is offered unless it was already made in this call. A refusal from the change service is treated as a statement-week error and goes to an agent.

notes: Unresolved or interpreted points (documents disagree or are silent): (1) Slow services: the documents allow 'Bilgilerinizi kontrol ediyorum.' while waiting but agree no timeout; the line is spoken before every cards.balance call because slowness cannot be detected in advance; timeout 20 s, one retry on read-only calls, none on statement.week.change / statement.pdf.send (contract 7.1). (2) No service tells whether the yearly statement-week right is used (contract 5.3, analysis 11.1): the change is offered unless it was already changed in this call; a refusal of statement.week.change is treated as a statement-week service error (agent). Limit sentence follows Kerem 7 Oct (once per calendar year), not the older IVR prompts (ayda bir / yilda uc). (3) After a successful e-mail or week change the workflow says 'Baska hangi konuda yardimci olabilirim?' (allowed by analysis 8.4) instead of ending at once, so follow-ups (another send, spouse request) are handled; 'nothing else' then ends with 'Sizi ana menuye yonlendiriyorum.'. (4) Angry callers: three calming replies counted in code (recap 9 Oct overrides the analysis 'one calming reply'), the fourth complaint transfers. (5) Product names are free text from the card system; a name longer than four words or 32 characters is not spoken and the card is introduced by its last four digits only (analysis 3.3 empty-name rule, security 8.6). (6) Not drafted by the bank, so not said: the line for foreign currency moved into Turkish Lira (analysis 4.4) and the future-period total in foreign currency on the no-debt reading (4.7). (7) Non-Turkish speech ends with 'Sizi ana menuye aktariyorum.' (Burcu 28 Sep, analysis 8.4); out-of-scope questions ask the 7 Oct question first. (8) The flow drawing's second-factor box was never built (Burcu 28 Sep), so no identity step.
